hero_title:
We're Not Just an LED Company.
We're Your Partner.
hero_sub: Family-owned. US-based. Built on the belief that great technology and genuine service aren't optional — they're the whole point.
story_paragraphs: Beza LED was born from a simple frustration: too many businesses were being sold expensive LED displays by companies that disappeared the moment installation was done.

We built something different. A US-based team that stays with you — from the first consultation to the moment your screen goes live, and every service call after that. Six years ago we started with a clear mission: deliver display technology that actually works, backed by people who actually answer the phone.

Today, we serve churches, production companies, retailers, airports, and event teams across the United States. Every installation comes with our full 5-year warranty, 24/7 US-based support, and the promise that we'll treat your investment like it's our own.
We're a family company. And we treat every client like family.
us_based_title: Real People. Real Support. Real Time.
us_based_text: All Beza LED products are designed, supported, and serviced in the United States. That means faster shipping, nationwide technicians, and a support team that operates in your timezone, speaks your language, and understands your market. When you call us at 2pm on a Tuesday or 9pm on a Saturday, a real person answers. That's not a feature — it's who we are.
